phase1.explanation:
🦀 **Default implementations provide common behavior.**

**Default implementation features:**

| Feature | Example |
|---------|---------|
| Default method | `fn desc(&self) -> String { self.name() }` |
| Required method | `fn name(&self) -> String;` |
| Override default | Implement the method in impl block |
| Calling default | Use default if not overridden |

**Rust-chan says:**
"Default implementations let you define common behavior once. Types can override if needed."

**When to use default implementations:**
| Situation | Use default |
|-----------|-------------|
| Common behavior | ✅ |
| Base implementation | ✅ |
| Optional methods | ✅ |
| All types should have it | ✅ |
